senses.sense_definition: The discharge of semen or other fluid from the body following sexual stimulation.

examples.text: Doctor explains that premature <w>ejaculation</w> is a common and treatable issue.
The patient reported pain during <w>ejaculation</w> and was advised to consult a specialist.

senses.sense_definition: A sudden, brief exclamation or short spoken outburst.

examples.text: She uttered a sudden <w>ejaculation</w> of surprise when the door flew open.
His brief <w>ejaculation</w> interrupted the quiet atmosphere of the library.

traits.comment: Used historically to describe a sudden exclamation or spoken word

senses.sense_definition: The sudden expulsion or ejection of liquid or matter from a duct or physical structure.

examples.text: Scientists observed the rapid <w>ejaculation</w> of spores from the fungus under a microscope.
The force of the sudden fluid <w>ejaculation</w> propels the mechanism forward.
